# BRKZ Secures $31 Million to Scale AI-Enabled Building Materials Procurement Across Saudi Arabia and the GCC
14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- [BRKZ](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=BeRV0xwM3-0Y0Of9S-Jc8eZWgRRZt7LPDKiJ7HYoYZ0KjYW6fBOay7gDwDIPSqM5URHGJlS33Qn7pURGa2O71359z_XxRtBYBLFd4Qlh1eA=), a leading technology-enabled building materials procurement platform in Saudi Arabia, today announced it has secured $31 million in new capital to fuel its next phase of growth, including advancing its AI-powered pricing and fulfillment engine and rolling out embedded financing solutions for its network of contractors and suppliers.

Earlier in 2026, BRKZ also received a strategic investment from SIC, the investment arm of the Saudi Industrial Development Fund (SIDF), reflecting SIC's confidence in BRKZ's vision to digitize procurement, strengthen local supply chains and contribute to the Kingdom's Vision 2030 industrial objectives.
